brief: Using official Python documentation, explain the difference between pathlib.Path.absolute() and Path.resolve(), including how each handles symlinks. Deliver a cited Markdown answer with one concise example.
Research official Python documentation on contextlib.ExitStack. Explain when it helps manage a variable number of context managers and how cleanup order works. Deliver a cited Markdown note.
Using official Python documentation, explain itertools.groupby and why its groups can appear surprising on unsorted input. Deliver a cited Markdown answer with a small example.
Use official Python documentation to explain the difference between dataclasses.asdict and astuple, including nested dataclasses. Deliver a cited Markdown comparison.
Research official SQLite documentation on foreign-key enforcement. Explain whether it is enabled by default and how an application can verify it. Deliver a cited Markdown checklist.
Using MDN, explain how IntersectionObserver can help defer work until an element approaches the viewport, including one limitation. Deliver a cited Markdown answer.
Use MDN to explain CSS clamp() for responsive typography, including what the minimum, preferred, and maximum arguments mean. Deliver a cited Markdown note with an example.
Using MDN, explain the difference between aria-label and aria-labelledby and when a visible label should be preferred. Deliver a cited Markdown checklist.
Use official Git documentation to explain git restore for unstaging a file versus restoring working-tree content. Deliver a cited Markdown guide that warns about discarding edits.
Use official Playwright Python documentation to explain auto-waiting for locator actions and when an explicit wait may still be needed. Deliver a short cited Markdown answer.

Build a responsive one-page site for fictional neighborhood repair cafe Fix & Found. Choose a welcoming visual direction; explain what visitors can bring, show illustrative session information, and provide a truthful inquiry path. Do not invent a real address or contact channel.

Build a responsive portfolio for a fictional paper artist named Isha Sen. Audience: curators and collaborators. Choose an original visual direction, include work categories and a collaboration invitation, and label all examples as illustrative. Do not invent awards, exhibitions, or contact details.

Build an accessible local demo page for a fictional city tree walk. Include route overview, three clearly illustrative stops, a readable mobile layout, and a local-only RSVP interaction that never claims to send data.

Build a local unit converter for Celsius/Fahrenheit and kilometers/miles. Make both directions work, reject invalid input clearly, and provide responsive accessible HTML/CSS/JS with a verified result.
Build a local reading-time estimator that accepts pasted text, counts words, lets the user select reading speed, and updates an accessible estimate. Provide runnable files and verify behavior.

Build a responsive launch page for fictional seed-sharing club Seed Circle. Include mission, how sharing works, three explicitly illustrative seed categories, and a no-backend interest form honestly labeled as local-only.
Build a local checklist app for packing a trip. Users must add, check, and remove items; persist state in localStorage; include keyboard-friendly controls and mobile layout. Verify core interactions.

Build a responsive FAQ and contact page for fictional community pottery space Kiln Room. Include accessible FAQ disclosure controls, clearly illustrative class policies, and a truthful contact path without invented email or phone.

Build a local tip-splitting calculator with bill, tip percentage, and party size. Guard against zero people and invalid amounts. Show total and per-person values accessibly in a responsive page; verify calculations.

Build a responsive editorial site for fictional oral-history project Voices of the Block. Include purpose, three sample story themes clearly marked as illustrative, accessibility-conscious typography, and a local-only contribution draft interaction.
Inspect official Python pathlib documentation and create a CSV comparing three Path methods for finding or matching files. Columns: method,purpose,evidence_url. Add a short cited Markdown note.
Inspect MDN documentation for button, label, and fieldset elements. Create JSON records with element,semantic_role,evidence_url, plus a cited Markdown note on accessible forms.
Inspect official Python itertools documentation and create a CSV for three iterator functions with function,behavior,evidence_url. Add a short cited Markdown summary.
Inspect official SQLite documentation for three aggregate functions. Produce a CSV with function,purpose,evidence_url and a short Markdown note citing inspected pages.
Inspect MDN documentation on three CSS layout properties: gap, align-items, and justify-content. Produce a JSON array with property,use,evidence_url and a cited Markdown summary.
Inspect official Python urllib.parse documentation. Produce a CSV of three URL parsing or construction functions with function,behavior,evidence_url, plus a cited Markdown note.
Inspect official Git documentation for git log, git show, and git diff. Produce a three-row CSV with command,purpose,evidence_url and a concise cited Markdown guide.
Inspect W3C WAI guidance about keyboard accessibility. Produce a cited Markdown checklist and a CSV with three interface situations,expected_keyboard_behavior,evidence_url.
Inspect MDN documentation on the Fetch API Response object. Create a JSON file describing ok, status, and json() with member,meaning,evidence_url; add a cited Markdown note.
Inspect official Python collections documentation for Counter, deque, and defaultdict. Produce a CSV with type,common_use,evidence_url and a short cited Markdown explanation.
